result: For EVERY complex rank-four Bob map K:C^5->C^4 whose one-dimensional kernel lies in span{|3>,|4>}, the actual normalized local projection of the explicitly specified 4x5 PPT/SN3 grid state R is PPT, entangled, and has Schmidt number EXACTLY 2. This includes ALL complex combinations of the last two Bob coordinates and both coordinate endpoints, with two explicit nonnegative decompositions. This is a proper family of 4x4 states, not a global 4x4 result or a target SN>=3 witness.
relationship_to_previous: This strictly strengthens and supersedes the annulus-only result frontier-20261028-grid-two-column-continuum-v1.json SHA256 386717d08d397b3cb4d8cfe8afc885f2006a2d9ef46a312f790216b8fd491226. The previously unproved ratios are now included. The all-hyperplane range-spanning obstruction remains a separate weaker statement that does not by itself imply SN<=2.
source_state: As in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9, put [q]=|q><q|; A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|34>, E=|20>+|33>, F=|23>, G=|30>, I=|32>, H=|04>, and R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H]). Exact certificates in that receipt show R/31 is PPT and SN=3. The source range is Krebs–Gachechiladze arXiv:2509.07086v1 Eq. (11); their 4x5 SN3 existence predates this work, and novelty of the projection theorem is not cleared.
normal_form_of_K: Because ker(K) is a line in span{|3>,|4>}, the images of |0>,|1>,|2> are independent and the images of |3>,|4> span one line independent of them. An invertible output change of basis therefore reduces K to K_uv: |0>,|1>,|2> map identically, |3> maps to u|3>, |4> maps to v|3>, where (u,v)!=(0,0). Invertible local output maps preserve PPT and Schmidt number, so it suffices to prove the normal form. Write R_uv=(I tensor K_uv) R (I tensor K_uv)^* and use primes for its projected nine vectors.
twirl: For z,w in {1,i,-1,-i}, set U_A=diag(1,z,z^2,w) and U_B=diag(1,z^(-1),z^(-2),z^2/w) on the 4x4 output. Let T(q)=(1/16) sum_(z^4=w^4=1)[(U_A tensor U_B)q]. Since z^4=1, this is compatible with the same phase on original Bob labels 3 and 4. The nine projected basis vectors have characters A':1, B':z^(-1), D':z, C'/E':z^2, F':w^(-1), G':w, I':w*z^2, H':z^2/w. All characters are distinct except C' and E'. Each seed below uses at most one of C',E', so all its mixed terms vanish in the finite twirl.

case_large.rank_proof: Its coefficient matrix has rows [1,1,1,3v/2], [-1,1,1,0], [0,1,1,3v/4], [4/3,0,0,v]. Column 2 equals column 1, and column 3 equals (3v/4)(column 0+column 1). The first two columns are independent, so the rank is exactly 2 for every complex v, including v=0.
case_large.decomposition: R_uv=T(q_L)+2[C']+3[E']+(3-9|p|^2/16)[F']+(11/9)[G']+3[I']+(3/4)[H']. The C/E shared-character issue does not arise because q_L has no E' coefficient. The condition |p|<=2 makes the F' coefficient at least 3/4; all other coefficients are strictly nonnegative.

case_small.rank_proof: Its coefficient matrix has rows [1,1,0,v], [-1,1,1,0], [-1,1,1,0], [-2p,0,p,-u]. Row 2 equals row 1 and row 3 equals -p times row 0 plus p times row 1, because u=pv. Rows 0 and 1 are independent, so the rank is exactly 2, including u=0.
case_small.decomposition: R_uv=T(q_S)+3[C']+2[E']+3[F']+(3-4|p|^2)[G']+(3-|p|^2)[I']+2[H']. The C/E shared-character issue does not arise because q_S has no C' coefficient. The condition |p|<=1/2 makes every coefficient nonnegative.

coverage_and_positivity: Every nonzero pair (u,v) is in at least one case: if |v|<=2|u| use the large case, otherwise v!=0 and |u|<|v|/2 use the small case. The boundary is covered by both formulas. Every twirled seed has SR=2 and all residual vectors have SR<=2, proving SN(R_uv)<=2 for ALL complex pairs. PPT follows independently from R^Gamma>=0 and R_uv^Gamma=(I tensor conjugate(K_uv))R^Gamma(I tensor conjugate(K_uv))^*.
entanglement: Local projection onto Alice and Bob labels 0,1,2 produces T=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([02]+[20]), independent of u,v. Its range is [[a,b,c],[d,a,b],[e,-d,a]]; a rank-one matrix has minors a^2-bd=a^2+bd=0, hence a=0, but A belongs to the range with a=1. Thus T is not separable. Local projection cannot create entanglement, so every R_uv is entangled and therefore SN exactly 2.

verification.observed: Six Gaussian-rational cases: large (u,v)=(1,2),(1,0),(1+i,1-i); small (0,1),(1,2),(i,3). For EACH, all 16 twirled seeds passed all sixteen 3x3 rank minors, every residual weight was nonnegative, and all 256 state entries matched exactly with zero mismatches. The two (1,2) cases independently check both formulas on the shared boundary; the other cases include zero endpoints and genuinely complex maps. All arithmetic is Fraction/Gaussian-rational, not floating.
verification.scope: The six checks are samples; the quantifier ALL complex pairs follows from the explicit column/row, twirl-character and positivity arguments above. No independent human, configured-family or formal/kernel review is claimed.

limits: This does not prove SN<=2 for all rank-four projections with arbitrary kernel direction, any 4x4 PPT state outside this explicit family, or any global decomposition theorem; it supplies no 4x4 SN>=3 pair. Novelty and source priority remain unchecked beyond the named primary sources.
